feature: E005-F005: CLI Detection and Installation Views
story: E005-F005-S001: Implement CLI setup views for onboarding flow
story_description: As a new user setting up Blaze, I need a clear CLI setup view that displays detection status for each supported CLI tool and provides one-click installation so that I can quickly configure my development environment without manual terminal commands.
task_description: Implement the OnboardingCLISetupView SwiftUI view that displays CLI detection results in a card-based layout, shows installation status badges, provides install buttons for missing CLIs, and integrates with CLISetupViewModel for state management and action dispatch.
atom_description: Create the OnboardingCLISetupView.swift file in Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/Views/ that renders the CLI detection screen with status cards for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Aider, OpenCode, and Amp. The view displays version info for installed CLIs, install buttons for missing ones, and recommended badges for suggested tools.
problem_statement: Users need a visually clear, actionable interface to understand which CLI tools are installed on their system and to install missing ones. Without this view, users would need to manually check terminal installations and run package manager commands, creating friction in the onboarding experience. The view must handle multiple CLI states (installed with version, not installed, installing, failed) and provide consistent visual feedback.

implementation_steps: Step 1: Create new file Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/Views/OnboardingCLISetupView.swift with standard header
Step 3: Define OnboardingCLISetupView struct with @ObservedObject viewModel: CLISetupViewModel
Step 4: Implement body computed property with conditional content based on viewModel state
Step 5: Create loadingView private computed property returning skeleton placeholder cards
Step 6: Create errorView private computed property returning error message with retry button
Step 7: Create contentView private computed property returning ScrollView with CLI cards
Step 8: Create cliCardRow private function accepting CLIItem parameter and returning card view
Step 9: Implement status badge view based on CLIItem.installState
Step 10: Implement action button (Install/Installing/Retry) based on CLIItem.installState
Step 11: Create footer view with Install All Missing, Skip, and Next buttons
Step 12: Add accessibility modifiers to all interactive elements
Step 13: Add preview provider with mock CLISetupViewModel for Xcode canvas
Step 14: Verify view compiles and renders in preview without errors

ui_states: State 1: Loading - Shows skeleton placeholder cards while detection runs
State 2: Error - Shows error message banner with Retry Detection button
State 3: Content - Shows list of CLI cards with current status
State 4: Installing - Individual card shows Installing badge with progress spinner
State 5: Complete - All selected CLIs installed, Next button enabled
ui_interactions: Interaction 1: Tap Install button on CLI card triggers single CLI installation
Interaction 2: Tap Install All Missing button triggers batch installation of all missing CLIs
Interaction 3: Tap Skip button bypasses CLI setup and proceeds to next onboarding step
Interaction 4: Tap Next button proceeds to next step when at least one CLI is installed
Interaction 5: Tap Retry Detection button re-runs CLI detection after error
Interaction 6: Tap Retry button on failed CLI card retries that specific installation
Interaction 7: Scroll gesture navigates through CLI list if content exceeds viewport
ui_copy: Subtitle: Blaze works with these AI coding assistants. Install at least one to continue.
Loading text: Detecting installed CLIs (with spinner)
Error text: Failed to detect CLIs. Please check your system PATH and try again.
Install All Missing button: Install All Missing
edge_cases: Edge case 1: All six CLIs already installed - Hide Install All Missing button, enable Next immediately
Edge case 2: No CLIs installed - Show warning that at least one is required, disable Next until one installs
Edge case 3: Installation succeeds but version detection fails - Show Installed badge without version number
Edge case 4: Multiple CLIs installing simultaneously - Each card shows independent Installing state
Edge case 5: Network error during installation - Show Failed badge with offline-friendly error message
Edge case 6: User has non-standard CLI locations - Detection may miss installed CLIs, provide manual path entry option in future
Edge case 7: Window resized very narrow - Cards should stack vertically and remain usable at 600pt minimum width
Edge case 8: User rapidly taps Install on multiple CLIs - Queue installations, do not duplicate requests
failure_modes: FM-001: CLISetupViewModel not injected causes view crash - Mitigation: Use @ObservedObject with required initializer, catch in preview provider
FM-002: Infinite re-render loop from bad state binding - Mitigation: Use proper Equatable conformance on CLIItem, avoid view-side state mutations
FM-003: Main thread blocked by synchronous detection - Mitigation: ViewModel uses async/await, view only observes published properties
FM-004: Memory leak from strong reference cycle - Mitigation: ViewModel uses weak self in closures, view is struct value type
FM-005: Accessibility labels missing causes VoiceOver confusion - Mitigation: Add accessibilityLabel to all interactive elements in implementation checklist
rollback_plan: Delete Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/Views/OnboardingCLISetupView.swift file. Remove import and usage from OnboardingCoordinator if already integrated. Revert to placeholder view or skip CLI detection screen in onboarding flow. No data migration required as view has no persistent storage.
